text:
Alice P.: quick sync — we need to lock the minimum operational + commercial commitments for the upcoming prod entry. items: SLA tiers, docs/runbooks, oncall coverage, pricing floor, and short-term support plan. who can own each?
Ben (Eng): I can own SLA proposal. quick note: 50ms p95 for small models is unrealistic for GA across regions. propose two tiers: Standard / Premium.
Ben (Eng): proposed minimum (draft):
```
Tier     | target p95 | max qps per node | fallback
Standard | 100ms      | 200              | degraded model (quantized)
Premium  | 50ms       | 500              | route to dedicated pool
```
Helen — Docs: I can draft GA docs and the quickstart. Need the final SLA numbers and the rollout plan to finish the runbook. ETA: quickstart v1 in 3 business days, runbook v1 in 7.
Carla - Support: support plan: we need triage guide + incident templates and escalation matrix before GA. Also request a 2-hour training for level-1 oncall. Without playbook, we’ll see slower TTR.
Erin (Sales): for pricing we need a baseline commit: what’s the minimum committed capacity for the Standard tier? Sales needs a price floor to give to customers and to protect unit economics. Also: request an "enterprise beta" option to allow SLA exceptions with surcharge.
Greg - Oncall: Monitoring/alerts quick wins: error-rate alert (5xx > 0.5% for 5m), latency-slo alert (p95 > tier threshold for 3m), cache hit-rate drop, and KV cache size warning. Need mappings to PagerDuty severities and runbook links. Who will author the initial alert playbook?
Alice P.: @Ben please own the SLA doc and a short POV on fallback policies. @Greg please draft alert -> PD mapping and mock sev levels. @Helen @Carla pair on the runbook and L1 training content. @Erin we need pricing floor proposal by EOD Wednesday so finance can sanity-check.
Ben (Eng): taking SLA + fallback. I’ll add a short cost estimate per 1k requests for each tier (rough).
Ben (Eng): note on fallbacks: we should be explicit in docs that degraded model returns are best-effort and may change latency/cost. need legal signoff for customer-facing wording.
Helen — Docs: will start with an internal runbook (sensitive wording) and public FAQ. pinging legal once Ben flags customer's SLA language.
Carla - Support: for GA support coverage I propose: 24/7 paging for P1 for first 6 weeks, then re-evaluate. level-1 triage script needs < 6 checkpoints. I’ll draft the script and post it here for review.
Erin (Sales): on pricing floor: if Standard is provisioned as shared-hosted, sales suggests a starting MRR equivalent to ~2000 reqs/sec committed (work with Ben on what that maps to on infra). we can mark "enterprise beta" with explicit surcharge + expedited support add-on.
Greg - Oncall: I’ll draft alert -> PD mapping today and link runbook placeholders. also request a smoke dashboard for first 72 hours of GA (latency, errors, cost burn).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary v1.12 pushed to staging (sha: a1b2c3). smoke tests started. :white_check_mark:
Alice P.: timeline recap:
- SLA + fallback (Ben) -> draft by EOD tomorrow
- Alert mappings + dashboard (Greg) -> draft today
- Runbook + L1 training (Helen + Carla) -> quickstart in 3d, runbook in 7d
- Pricing floor + enterprise beta proposal (Erin + Ben) -> EOD Wed
- Legal signoff on public SLA wording -> request after Ben draft
If any blockers call them out now so we can escalate.
Ben (Eng): blocker: need realistic perf numbers from perf infra. @infra-team please share recent p95s for the small and medium models.
Carla - Support: blocker: need an offboarding checklist for non-GA customers (so we don’t escalate to GA support inadvertently). I’ll draft and share.
Helen — Docs: question: should the runbook include an ops checklist for feature flags + AB tests? I think yes — better to be explicit.
Alice P.: yes include feature-flag gating and rollback steps.
Erin (Sales): also: can we include a short "what to tell customers" script for AE demos (one-paragraph description of SLA and known limits)?
Helen — Docs: will add a one-paragraph customer-facing blurb and an internal expanded description.
Greg - Oncall: FYI I’ll schedule a 30-min dry-run of the runbook with the oncall team next week.
Alice P.: thanks everyone. I’ll compile owner list and send the final checklist after we have Ben’s SLA numbers. :rocket:
